title: State Machines and Commands
description: Give the shooter a state machine and control it with commands bound to buttons, then build an aim state that turns the robot to face the goal and tune its PID by hand.

checkpoints.title: Button bindings
checkpoints.description: OI binds the right bumper to ShooterCommands.shoot() and A to simulateBallLaunch().

checkpoints.title: Spins up before shooting
checkpoints.description: Hold the right bumper until the shooter reaches SHOOT. It must pass through SPIN_UP first (IDLE cannot jump to SHOOT).

checkpoints.title: Recovers after a launch
checkpoints.description: Hold the right bumper, then tap A. The shooter should fall back to SPIN_UP and return to SHOOT, so the shot count reaches 2.

checkpoints.title: Aim state written
checkpoints.description: DriveStates has AIM, the switch handles it with a PIDController (continuous input), getAngleToGoal() and isAimed() are written, and DrivetrainCommands.aim() starts and ends the state.

checkpoints.title: Aims within 2 degrees
checkpoints.description: Start fresh, enable Teleop and hold the left bumper (E). The robot should turn to face the goal and stay within 2 degrees of it for half a second, within 4 seconds. Raise AIM_KP if it stops short.

checkpoints.title: No wild overshoot
checkpoints.description: On that same aim, the robot must not swing more than 10 degrees past the goal. Lower AIM_KP or add AIM_KD to damp it.
